{{Top|leg}}
The '''sensory-response module''' was part of a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Behavioral circuitry matrix/Legends|behavioral circuitry matrix]].<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> It was made up of [[audio-visual circuit]]s, an [[olfactory-speech center]], a [[Gyro-balance circuitry|gyro-balance unit]], a [[spectrum analysis unit]], and an [[extremity control system]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|67|behavioral circuitry matrix}}</ref>
